summary: Main update-manifest.json points to a full 389848-byte, 29-chunk package with SHA-256 eb8fbc66c20f6dd976018d35fc89aac11023360e5dc3f40c0164be7452fd2126. The separate local source ZIP labelled v0.3.57 was 398312 bytes, SHA-256 a29c4863f9321dce98fa5e07c5178fce433d4d212debdd402730ffa48541e4c5, and embeds 0.3.36; it is not the published updater package. The new reproducible patch combines the existing shared-entry owner+0x10 capture with RCX/RDX/[RDX+0x10] snapshot at the same logical-entry hook, preserving separate root-add measurement. Latest upload remains the 0.3.35 artifact and has no registers.
